name: Spaceship 61627500 on the 2-uniform tiling k2-004
description: A period-3 spaceship on the 2-uniform tiling k2-004 (touching neighbours), 4 to 6 cells, moving one lattice step every 3 generations (c/3). It runs the same way in the 2,048 rules from B3/S35 to B3,6,7,8,9,10/S0,3,5,6,7,8,9,10; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 19 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
